question: Should OpenClaw intentionally treat whitespace-only Google Vertex project and location environment values as unset, even when an existing deployment currently passes them through to the Google SDK?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and consistent with the stated sibling behavior, but this is an upgrade-visible change to provider configuration fallback semantics rather than a purely internal refactor.

options.title: Confirm normalized fallback behavior
options.body: Merge the PR and make OpenClaw's missing-project or missing-location errors the canonical result for blank Vertex environment values.

options.title: Preserve SDK pass-through
options.body: Keep the current behavior if maintainers consider whitespace-only environment values an external SDK compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm normalized fallback behavior
recommendation.body: Merge the PR and make OpenClaw's missing-project or missing-location errors the canonical result for blank Vertex environment values.
